request: The Acme daily load pipeline failed last night in DEV. I think we just need to add a retry, do it.
must: Starts by reading the error: asks for the exact error text and the status of every step inside the item, not only of the item
Asks for one named query result at a time and not 'the logs'
Says a diagnosis is read-only and the fix is planned and approved before any change
Checks the known-causes table before guessing, and says a retry is only for a step that is safe to repeat and a documented transient cause
Says that after 3 failed fix attempts it stops and reports what was tried and what it suspects
must_not: Adds a retry or any fix before reading the error
Proposes the same fix a fourth time after three failures
